document.cue: Describe a neighbour you know well.

text: The neighbour I know best is a retired engineer called Bolat, who lives on the same floor as my family in a nine-storey block in Almaty. We've been neighbours for about twelve years now, ever since we moved into the building when I was still at primary school.

At first I only knew him as the man who fixed everything. If someone's door lock broke or a pipe started leaking, people would knock on his door rather than call a plumber, and he never asked for anything in return. These days we mostly chat on the landing or in the lift — about football, rising prices and how the neighbourhood has changed.

One moment that really brought us closer was a few winters ago, when the heating in our flat stopped working on a freezing weekend. My parents were away, and I had no idea what to do, but he spent the whole evening helping me find the problem with the radiator.
I think we get on well because he treats me as an equal rather than as a kid. He's genuinely interested in my studies, and he's always happy to share advice without lecturing me.
In a big city where most people don't even know who lives next door, I feel quite lucky to have someone like him nearby.

tips.en: At first and These days cover the “what you do together” bullet and show a range of tenses.
tips.kk: At first … These days — «бірге не істейсіз» тармағын ашып, әртүрлі шақты көрсетудің оңай жолы.
tips.ru: At first … These days — так легко раскрыть пункт «что делаете вместе» и показать разные времена.
tips.example: At first I only knew him as the man who fixed everything

tips.en: Treats me as an equal rather than as a kid is more precise than “he is kind”.
tips.kk: Treats me as an equal rather than as a kid — «ол мейірімді» дегеннен дәлірек.
tips.ru: Treats me as an equal rather than as a kid — точнее, чем «он добрый».
tips.example: he treats me as an equal rather than as a kid

note.en: Who and where: name, former job, the same floor — and straight away how long they have known each other.
note.kk: Кім және қайда: аты, бұрынғы мамандығы, бір қабатта тұрады — және бірден «қанша жылдан бері таныс».
note.ru: Кто и где: имя, бывшая профессия, тот же этаж — и сразу «сколько лет знакомы».

note.en: What they usually do together — shown through his reputation in the building and their usual topics.
note.kk: Әдетте не істейді — үйде оны қалай танитыны және әңгіме тақырыптары арқылы.
note.ru: Что обычно делают вместе — через то, каким его знают в доме, и темы разговоров.

note.en: One story (the broken heating) shows how they became closer.
note.kk: Бір оқиға (жылу өшіп қалғаны) олардың қалай жақындасқанын көрсетеді.
note.ru: Одна история (отключилось отопление) показывает, как они сблизились.

note.en: Why they get on — two concrete reasons instead of a vague “he is nice”.
note.kk: Неге тіл табысады — «ол жақсы адам» деген жалпы сөздің орнына екі нақты себеп.
note.ru: Почему ладят — две конкретные причины вместо общего «он хороший».

note.en: A conclusion wider than the story — a contrast with life in a big city.
note.kk: Оқиғадан кеңірек қорытынды — үлкен қаладағы өмірмен салыстыру.
note.ru: Вывод шире истории — контраст с жизнью в большом городе.

what you usually talk about or do together
